source.title: Dog saved from starving, owner arrested
source.rights: Florida public record (Fla. Stat. ch. 119), released by the agency; Florida agencies cannot claim copyright in public records (Microdecisions, Inc. v. Skinner, 889 So. 2d 871, Fla. 2d DCA 2004). Faces of bystanders are blurred in anything we publish; names of arrested people are not used.

report:
When found, the dog's body was covered in sores and he was weak.
The dog has gained a significant amount of weight since he was admitted to the shelter.
The owner was arrested.
The owner denied the neglect.
The owner asked for his mom.
A pipe was found in the owner's pocket.
The owner thanked the detectives for taking care of the dog.
The owner was arrested inside a moving car during a traffic stop.
